title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Friday 27 November, 10am.** The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £155.98** at Amazon (still a record low), the **LG C6 65-inch OLED at £1,529.10** at Amazon (its lowest yet) and the **Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 at £109.99** at Amazon (about a third of its list price).

It's Black Friday today, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday, 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. New this morning: the Kindle Colorsoft at £144.99, the Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99, the Ember 50-inch 4K TV at £269.99, the Dyson V8 at £199.99, the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo at £379, the Oura Ring 5 at £299 and the Apple Watch Series 11 (cellular) at £345.67, all at Amazon. We took off deals we couldn't re-confirm since yesterday, including the Roborock Qrevo S Pro, the Hisense Canvas TV, the Sonos Beam and the Lego Road Bike. **PS5 buyers:** consoles are still mostly sold out; see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/). Prices were reported on 26–27 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

body:
## Tech

Apple: the AirPods Pro 3 are still a record-low £155.98 at Amazon, a single AirTag is £20.50 and the Apple Watch Series 11 with cellular is £345.67, all at Amazon. Apple's own Black Friday event (27–30 November) gives a gift card rather than a discount, so Amazon is cheaper. Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Colorsoft is £144.99, the basic Kindle £119.99, the Echo Dot £49.99, the Fire TV Stick 4K £31.99, the Ring Battery Doorbell with an Indoor Camera £39.99 and a Blink Outdoor 4 + Mini 2K+ pair £24.99. For TVs, the Ember 50-inch 4K is £269.99 and the LG C6 65-inch OLED is down to £1,529.10.

For audio, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are £126, the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds £99 and the Sony WH-1000XM4C £161.10. The Oura Ring 5 is a lowest-ever £299. Gamers: the Switch 2 with Switch Sports Resort is £399 and the DualSense £42.99, but PS5 consoles are still hard to find.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Echo](/guides/echo-dot-deals-uk/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [smartwatches](/guides/smartwatch-deals-uk/), [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

The Dyson V8 is £199.99 at Amazon, the cheapest way into a Dyson stick vacuum. In the kitchen, the Ninja AF300UK dual-drawer air fryer is £119, the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer £99 and the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo bean-to-cup machine £379, all at Amazon. For robot vacuums, see our [robot vacuum guide](/guides/robot-vacuum-deals-uk/).

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

For teeth, the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 is £109.99 and the Suri Pro sonic toothbrush £83.98, both at Amazon. For hair, see our [Dyson Airwrap price guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/). For fragrance gifts, [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those today. The Lego Game Boy is a lowest-ever £35.99 and the Lego Classic Large Creative Brick Box £28.99, both at Amazon. For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/), [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Today, Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Cyber Monday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', buy it: Cyber Monday prices are usually the same or slightly worse, and popular items sell out. Items marked 'Good price' could still dip a little by Monday.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices.
